name: ADMM Solver
definition: A technique to solve minimization problems of the form min_x f(x) + g(x) with variable x and objectives f(x) and g(x) that are separable. f(x) is a data term measuring goodness of fit, g(x) is a prior term measuring deviation from expectations.
summary: The ADMM Solver optimizes separable minimization by decoupling objectives into alternating subproblems and maintaining a dual variable for consensus, distinguishing it from direct and primal-dual methods.
